public_synthetic_group.objective_comparison: Against the frozen criteria, baseline and candidate both meet every listed check. The candidate expresses the H01 change-impact record in a more explicit source/artifact/check/status table; the baseline conveys the same required semantics with a status table plus prose. This presentation difference does not establish higher correctness. H02 and H03 are substantively equivalent for rubric purposes.

regression_group.objective_comparison: Old and new both meet every frozen regression check. The new output makes per-artifact freshness and completed/not-performed status more explicit in a change-impact table. The old output already requires v2-specific regeneration and checking and permits unrelated work to continue, so this added explicitness is not a criterion-level pass/fail difference.

limitations: Longer tables, more modules read, or a larger number of self-reported checks were not treated as evidence of superior quality.
Run logs are agent self-reports, not complete tool traces; they support scope statements but cannot independently prove every claimed action or omission.
This assessment checks output conformity to the frozen synthetic rubrics. Scientific correctness, statistical validity, and artifact-level integrity still require expert and data-level review.
